subject.title: Feature Request: Surface API provider name in error/overload messages

question: Should OpenClaw expose only provider/model in transient user-facing error messages, or accept the broader sanitized context shape proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/55851?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent visible diagnostics and privacy boundary are product choices, and an open linked PR already implements one candidate shape.

options.title: Review and narrow/adopt the linked PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/55851 as the canonical implementation path, with maintainer review deciding the final safe context fields.

options.title: Provider/model only
options.body: Ask the PR author or a repair worker to reduce the visible copy to provider/model and keep profile, trigger, session, and request identifiers out of chat replies.

options.title: Keep generic copy
options.body: Reject the user-visible context change and close the linked PR and duplicate issues with a privacy/support rationale.

recommendation.title: Review and narrow/adopt the linked PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/55851 as the canonical implementation path, with maintainer review deciding the final safe context fields.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership evidence ties `steipete` to the central AI runtime extraction surface, and this choice is about product-visible diagnostics rather than only a mechanical formatter patch.
